caption: The drawing depicts a wooden bench constructed for two people, featuring two distinct backrests joined together, each with a horizontal top rail and three vertical slats adorned with ornamental cut-out shapes. The wood is a dark, almost black color with slight streaks of lighter brown, indicating grain and texture. The bench seat is woven from a light tan material, likely rush or straw, with a diagonal pattern visible where the fibers intersect at the center. The bench has four sturdy legs, with turning details at the base at front, and they are connected horizontally by spindled stretchers, including one stretcher with a circular knob detail in the center. Both sides of the bench have armrests comprised of a horizontal rail and five turned spindles connecting to the seat. The drawing is presented on a plain, off-white background with no additional objects or shading, and there is a small inscription or signature at the lower right corner.
title: Settee
